item.title: Efficient Python List Operation: Applying Functions to All Elements
item.description:
“Efficient Python List Operation: Applying Functions to All Elements”

How can one execute a specific function or operation on every single element within a Python list, generating either a new list or modifying the original list directly? Several performant and idiomatic approaches exist for this common data manipulation task.

1. Leveraging List Comprehensions for New List Creation

List comprehensions offer a concise and often highly readable way to generate a resulting list by iterating over an existing iterable. They are frequently favored for creating new lists based on transformations.
